most_similar_reason: Candidate 3 shares the target's core plot almost point for point: a deity resolves to destroy wicked mankind with a flood, one favored man is commanded to build a great vessel, he loads family and animals, all others perish, and after the waters recede he offers a sacrifice and receives a divine blessing/covenant.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 has no flood, no vessel, no quest for immortality and no divine boon—only a clever warrior-prince in a military coalition and variant accounts of his murder—so it shares nothing distinctive with the target.
